verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a cloud-backed coding agent, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents choosing a storage region. Bringing your own OpenAI-compatible or self-hosted model (byteask-docs-8, byteask-docs-9) only controls where inference runs, which is adjacent and not region selection. The llms.txt probe mentions a 'data-handling policy' but gives no residency or region controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
